name: Apurv Tanaji Londhe
bio: I build modern, responsive, and user-friendly web applications using the MERN stack and Next.js. I enjoy turning ideas into real-world digital experiences and continuously improving my development skills.
about: I am a self-taught Full Stack Developer passionate about creating modern and scalable web applications. My primary expertise includes HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, JSON, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. I enjoy building projects that solve real problems and help me grow as a developer. I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and continuously learning new technologies. Currently, I am focused on strengthening my full-stack development skills, building production-ready projects, and preparing for professional opportunities in the software industry.
